title: hey everyone, we need your feedback!
author: IronForgeEmperor
selftext:
Hello there,

me and my friends have been making a game, we are all RTS and card game veterans, and we would love to share our creation with you, we have been using AI but have spent many many hours trying to re-fine and balance

[www.mech-slap.com](http://www.mech-slap.com/)

Mech Slap is a turn-based multiplayer card game we have been building. we tried to add more strategic balance by having a "board" to play on.

Currently there is 2 factions — Forge Legion vs Last United Front, you can play against the AI, multiplayer and even 2v2 team games. We are already full of ideas for new factions too!

You can sign up or play as a guest, what we really want is your feedback, balancing and feel of the game, this is our first time doing something like this, so feel free to give honest opinions.

We hope to see you soon!

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/IronForgeEmperor please add a bit about how you used AI and what the development process looked like. Rule 4 exists so promotional posts contribute to the conversation about making games. We want to avoid the sub getting drowned in low-effort promotion. If this isn't updated, it may be removed.

replies.author: IronForgeEmperor
replies.body: I updated the post, hope its ok now.
